chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Ibn Udhaynah and Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the woman who gives birth, is it permissible for her to marry before she becomes pure? He said: 'When she gives birth, she may marry, but her husband may not have sexual intercourse with her until she becomes pure.'
ai.seo_question: Can a woman marry immediately after childbirth before her ritual purification is complete?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the distinction between the validity of the marriage contract (nikah) and the permissibility of sexual intercourse (dakhala) in the context of postpartum bleeding (nifas). It establishes that while the legal bond is immediate, the physical consummation is deferred until the cessation of bleeding and ritual purification, reflecting the practical application of purity laws in Shia jurisprudence. This ruling underscores the principle that nifas bleeding renders a woman ritually impure for prayer and intercourse, yet does not invalidate the marital status itself.
